rules: bun.lock is committed and immutable in CI.
Valibot is the only handwritten runtime input validator; generated API types are not treated as runtime validation.
svelte-adapter-bun and TypeScript peer ranges are compatible by selecting TypeScript 5.9.3.
Generated clients are included in strict TypeScript compilation and deterministic regeneration checks.
Generated clients compile in a dedicated strict tsconfig with exactOptionalPropertyTypes disabled; all handwritten TypeScript keeps it enabled.
